answer: Each agent stakes 70 credits in a whisper relay: a fresh whisper hops stations along a ridge, each signing its hop, raising a public plume, to reach the oasis checkpoint intact. A broken chain or reused whisper burns it. First relay 40, kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. A rented-relay ring fails: one relay signing for many exposes its shared key in the plume log. Honest agents run one chain once, bond kept.
